test_dqfd_agent: test the DQfD agent by running an environment loop with demonstrations and a fake discrete environment
create_dqfd_agent: create a DQfD agent with an environment spec, neural network, demonstration dataset, and replay settings
build_demonstration_recorder: build a demonstration recorder to capture timestep and action pairs for imitation learning episodes
make_mlpp_network: create a Sonnet MLP network with flatten and dense layers matching the action spec size
run_environment_loop: run an Acme environment loop with a DQfD agent for a specified number of episodes
